Title: Requires the disclosure of digitally altered images in an advertisement or other promotional material for the sale or lease of real property
Summary: Requires the disclosure of digitally altered images in an advertisement or other promotional material for the sale or lease of real property; requires the website posting to include the unaltered version of the image.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the real property law, in relation to requiring the disclosure of digitally altered images in an advertisement or other promotional material for the sale or lease of real property
